evidence_L0019.caveat: Ridge projector was trained on real donor–TTM token pairs, and real/permuted arms shared that initialization

scientific_question: Does pretrained donor token-structured information give excess correctly-aligned assignment benefit beyond an equally target-fitted projector and spectrum-matched semantically unstructured donor null?

constraints.model: TTM-Small-4M hidden256 vocab2048 context256 four blocks four heads untied LM head
constraints.unmapped_fallback_source: E0 original TTM; 130 fragments plus EOS
constraints.pretrained_donor: Pinned EmbeddingGemma2 input token rows 2048x512 from existing candidate_initialization.pt

arms.projector: ridge fitted on the 1438 anchor token pairs of this arm
ridge independently fitted on same 1438 token anchors after permutation
ridge independently fitted on same 1438 token anchors
ridge independently fitted on same 1438 token anchors after permutation

spectral_null.source: centered real donor mapped-row matrix X
spectral_null.construction: U_new sampled as orthonormal columns perpendicular to all-ones vector, then X_null=mean(X)+U_new*S*V^T

training.trainable: 512->256 projector + Transformer blocks + learned position + untied LM head, same counts and masks for all arms

estimand.loss: token-weighted answer-only NLL, same holdout token windows for all arms and seeds
estimand.sign: positive means an excess correct-token advantage from pretrained relative to spectrum-null under equal separately fitted-projector procedure
estimand.robustness: three fixed training-seed/null realizations, 3 of 3 tau_specific positive

bootstrap.method: sample 768 story IDs paired across all 12 runs; fixed seed list conditional, 2000 shared draws; percentile two-sided 95% on mean tau_specific across 3 fixed seeds
bootstrap.important_limit: not a population-over-seeds 95% CI; n=3 cannot establish generalization to all training seeds

proposed_decision_gate.pass: All 12 arms complete at frozen budget; independent audit PASS; each of 3 finite-seed tau_specific >0; conditional-on-three-seeds paired-story bootstrap CI95 lower(mean tau_specific)>0; geometric control diagnostics within preregistered acceptability envelope or verdict narrowed to observed rather than causal-specific effect
proposed_decision_gate.fail: Scientifically valid and completed study does not meet the whole intersection; do not switch to another contrast or automatically add more seeds
proposed_decision_gate.hold: No valid new holdout, source/rights defect, geometry/null construction mismatch, incomplete one-shot, missing READY or insufficient free T4/Drive; no scientific FAIL inferred

interpretation_limits: Spectrum matching preserves global covariance but not per-token norms, lexical neighborhoods, or all higher moments
Separate target-fitted projectors have same data access, but can produce unequal initialization fit errors; cannot assert exact geometry matching
A positive difference-in-differences is stronger evidence for pretrained donor structure than L0019, not proof of pure lexical semantics
All runs start from one pre-trained TTM source checkpoint and one EmbeddingGemma2 donor; 3 seeds vary adaptation and null realization, not donor pretraining corpus/seed
768-stories remain TinyStories-valid same domain; donor pretraining contamination unknown
No matched non-donor baseline, so no new absolute benefit-over-baseline claim
